name: ThirdShotHub Courtside Cooler Backpack
description: The ThirdShotHub Courtside Cooler Backpack is made for long tournament days. Alongside a padded sleeve for two paddles and a ventilated shoe tunnel, it has a leak-proof insulated cooler compartment that holds four 16 oz drinks and keeps them cold for up to 6 hours. A fence hook lets you hang it on the court fence so your gear stays off the ground.

specifications.cooler: Insulated, leak-proof; fits four 16 oz drinks; keeps cold up to 6 hours

care_instructions: Empty and wipe out the cooler compartment after each use and leave it unzipped to air-dry. Spot clean the exterior with mild soap and water; do not machine wash.
